form.label: Imperva IOC Block V2 – Blocked IPs / Unblock / Auto unblock
form.description: IPs blocked on the WAF: your policy read live from Imperva, the other enabled policies from the policy cache (5 min). Click rows to select, then 🔓 UNBLOCK (from whichever policy holds the IP) or set the auto unblock rule. Auto unblock: cloud provider / shared IPs after 7 days without an attack, other IPs after 60 days, every day at 02:17. Every action is written to the audit log; Auto unblock run now, the policies and the unblock log are on the Audit log page.

search.query: | impervalist | eval _refresh=$b_refresh|s$ | lookup imperva_block_registry site_id ip OUTPUT status AS reg_status blocked_at blocked_by incident_no comment source | append [| inputlookup imperva_block_registry where status="blocked" | eval in_waf="no" | rename status AS reg_status | fields site_id ip in_waf reg_status blocked_at blocked_by incident_no comment source] | stats max(in_waf) AS in_waf values(site_name) AS site_name values(reg_status) AS reg_status max(blocked_at) AS blocked_at values(blocked_by) AS blocked_by values(incident_no) AS incident_no values(comment) AS comment values(source) AS source values(detail) AS detail max(checked_at) AS checked_at BY site_id ip | eventstats max(eval(if(in_waf="error",1,0))) AS site_err max(checked_at) AS last_check BY site_id | where (ip!="-" AND in_waf!="empty") OR in_waf="error" | eval verification=case(in_waf="error", "⚠ Cannot read WAF: ".mvjoin(detail," "), in_waf="yes" AND reg_status="blocked", "✔ Verified on WAF", in_waf="yes", "✔ On WAF (blocked outside Splunk)", site_err=1, "⚠ Unknown (WAF read error)", true(), "✖ NOT on WAF - removed outside Splunk") | eval since=if(isnotnull(blocked_at), strftime(blocked_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "-") | eval ticket=coalesce(mvjoin(mvmap(incident_no, replace(incident_no, "(?i)ITHM\s*-?\s*", "")), ", "), "-"), description=coalesce(mvjoin(comment, "; "), "-"), blocked_by=coalesce(mvjoin(blocked_by, ", "), "-") | impervaautounblock action=annotate field=ip policy_field=site_id | eval policy=site_id, policy_name=coalesce(auto_policy_name, mvjoin(site_name, ", "), "-"), own_policy="yes", owner=coalesce(auto_owner, "-") | append [| makeresults | impervaautounblock action=list | where own_policy="no" | eval site_id=policy_id, policy=policy_id, in_waf="yes", verification="✔ On WAF (other policy)", since=listed_since." (listed)" | rename unblock_after AS auto_unblock_after, last_attack AS auto_last_attack, attacks_24h AS auto_attacks_24h, unblock_on AS auto_unblock_on, days_left AS auto_days_left, status AS auto_status, status_code AS auto_status_code, short_block AS auto_short_block | fields site_id ip policy policy_name own_policy owner in_waf verification since ticket description blocked_by auto_*] | eval auto_status=case(like(verification, "✖%"), "✖ NOT on WAF - removed outside Splunk", like(verification, "⚠%"), verification, true(), coalesce(auto_status, "-")), auto_status_code=if(like(verification, "✖%"), "not_on_waf", coalesce(auto_status_code, "-")), auto_attacks_24h=coalesce(auto_attacks_24h, 0) | eval _ord=case(auto_status_code="not_on_waf", 0, like(verification, "⚠%"), 1, true(), 2), _un=if(isnull(auto_unblock_on) OR auto_unblock_on="-", "9999", auto_unblock_on) | eval policy=policy." ".policy_name, since=if(since="-", null(), since), ticket=if(ticket="-", null(), ticket), description=if(description="-", null(), description), blocked_by=if(blocked_by="-", null(), blocked_by) | fillnull value="-" auto_status auto_last_attack auto_unblock_after auto_unblock_on auto_days_left auto_short_block owner verification | sort 0 ip, _ord, -str(_un) | stats first(auto_status) AS auto_status first(auto_status_code) AS auto_status_code first(auto_last_attack) AS auto_last_attack max(auto_attacks_24h) AS auto_attacks_24h first(auto_unblock_after) AS auto_unblock_after first(auto_unblock_on) AS auto_unblock_on first(auto_days_left) AS auto_days_left first(auto_short_block) AS auto_short_block first(owner) AS owner first(verification) AS verification first(_ord) AS _ord first(_un) AS _un max(in_waf) AS in_waf values(own_policy) AS own_policy values(policy) AS policy min(since) AS since values(ticket) AS ticket values(description) AS description values(blocked_by) AS blocked_by BY ip | eval since=coalesce(since, "-"), ticket=coalesce(mvjoin(ticket, ", "), "-"), description=coalesce(mvjoin(description, "; "), "-"), blocked_by=coalesce(mvjoin(blocked_by, ", "), "-") | sort 0 _ord _un ip

div.span: ☁ Cloud provider / shared IP: 7 days without an attack
Other IPs: 60 days without an attack
Rounds of 10 IPs, each confirmed on the WAF · no daily limit
every day 02:17 · fixed values · the countdown starts at the latest of the last attack (Imperva "Blocked IP" log), the block date and the day V2 first saw the rule

input.label: 🔎 Search IP / Ticket / Incident no. / Description / Policy (* = all)

search.query: | makeresults | eval ip=split("-,".trim($b_sel|s$, ","), ",") | mvexpand ip | where ip!="" AND ip!="-" | stats count BY ip | where count%2=1 | stats count AS _c values(ip) AS ip | eval ips=coalesce(mvjoin(ip, ","), ""), n=if(ips="", 0, coalesce(mvcount(split(ips, ",")), 0)) | eval Action=if(n=0, "Click rows below to select IPs", "🔓 UNBLOCK ".n." IP".if(n=1, "", "s")), Clear=if(n=0, "-", "✖ Clear selection") | eval selected_ips=if(n=0, "-", replace(ips, ",", ", ")), ticket=$b_tk|s$, description=$b_desc|s$ | table Action Clear selected_ips ticket description

panel.title: Unblock result – from the policy that holds each IP, written to the audit log (click a row to close)

search.query: | makeresults | impervaautounblock action=unblock ip=$b_exec_ips|s$ incident_no=$b_exec_tk|s$ description=$b_exec_desc|s$ | `imperva_audit_write` | table time ip action status verified policy ticket description backend soar_container detail

panel.title: Auto unblock rule for the selected IPs – does not change the WAF, only when the IP is unblocked

search.query: | makeresults | eval ip=split("-,".trim($b_sel|s$, ","), ",") | mvexpand ip | where ip!="" AND ip!="-" | stats count BY ip | where count%2=1 | stats count AS n values(ip) AS ip | eval n=coalesce(n, 0), ips=coalesce(mvjoin(ip, ", "), "") | eval Apply=if(n=0, "Select IPs in the table below", "✔ APPLY RULE to ".n." IP".if(n=1, "", "s")), selected_ips=if(n=0, "-", ips), rule=$b_rule|s$, reason=$b_desc|s$ | table Apply selected_ips rule reason

panel.title: Auto unblock rule saved – written to the audit log (click a row to close)

search.query: | makeresults | impervaautounblock action=set ip=$b_rule_ips|s$ rule=$b_rule_val|s$ reason=$b_rule_why|s$ | `imperva_audit_write` | table time ip policy action status detail description

panel.title: IPs blocked on the WAF – all policies, one row per IP (an IP in several policies lists them all; Unblock removes it from every one), sorted by unblock date – click a row to select / unselect it

search.query: | eval _q=replace(lower(trim(replace($b_q|s$, "[*]", ""))), "^ithm[\s:#-]*", ""), _f=$b_f|s$ | where _q="" OR like(lower(ip." ".ticket." ".description." ".blocked_by." ".mvjoin(policy, " ")." ".owner), "%"._q."%") | where _f="all" OR auto_status_code=_f OR (_f="own" AND isnotnull(mvfind(own_policy, "^yes$"))) OR (_f="other" AND isnotnull(mvfind(own_policy, "^no$"))) OR (_f="cloud" AND isnotnull(auto_short_block) AND auto_short_block!="-") | eval Events="🔍 Search" | table ip auto_status auto_last_attack auto_attacks_24h auto_unblock_after auto_unblock_on auto_days_left owner auto_short_block policy since ticket description blocked_by Events | rename auto_status AS Status, auto_last_attack AS "Last attack", auto_attacks_24h AS "Attacks 24h", auto_unblock_after AS "Unblock after", auto_unblock_on AS "Unblock on", auto_days_left AS "Days left", auto_short_block AS "Cloud / shared", since AS "Blocked / listed since", blocked_by AS "Blocked by"

format.colorPalette: case(like(value,"Due%"),"#5A9BD5", like(value,"Attacking%"),"#DC4E41", like(value,"Unblock soon%"),"#F8BE34", like(value,"Kept%"),"#53A051", like(value,"✖%"),"#DC4E41", like(value,"⚠%"),"#F8BE34", true(),"#3C444D")
